_about: Zones whose creatures are lifted to a level band as the world loads (docs/world/WORLD_SPINE.md section 5: the Frostmarch raised to 20-35, to fill the level-30s gap). src/regions.py relevel: each creature that spawns in the zone gains `add` levels, held within [lo, hi] (one already above hi keeps its level), and takes at least the standard numbers of its new level (population.numbers: never fewer than it had). The zone files are untouched: take a zone out of here and it is as it was.
